script_text: Uranus is cracking open your 1st House like lightning striking a thunderstorm, Aquarius—your identity is about to undergo a quantum leap this week. Monday through Wednesday, Mars in your 7th House squares your natal Sun, making partnerships volatile and self-expression combative; Tuesday is your worst day because Saturn in your 10th House crushes career momentum with harsh squares to Pluto. Thursday's Mercury sextile Neptune in your 9th House sparks intuitive insights about your future path—that's your turning point. Friday into the weekend, Venus enters your 5th House, igniting passionate romance or creative projects that could redefine your social circle. Wednesday is your power day because Jupiter trines your Uranus, unlocking unexpected opportunities. Saturday is toxic due to the Moon in your 8th House squaring Mars, stirring power struggles in close relationships. Avoid major decisions Thursday-Sunday—wait for next week's clearer skies. Your ruling planet Uranus demands you break free from old patterns to embrace your authentic revolution.
